root_cause_analysis: Meta Graph API returned code 4 with subcode 2207051 ('Application request limit reached / Action is blocked'). The account or application has triggered Meta's automated rate limiting or community activity block policy.
actionable_instructions: Check the Instagram Business / Facebook Page dashboard for any account action blocks or policy warnings.
Cease automated publishing calls to Instagram for 24 hours to allow the application request limit/spam block to clear.
Verify Meta Developer App request volume and status in the App Dashboard under App Review & Rate Limits.
